keyEvents.text: Félix Correia (Sevilla) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury Peque Fernández (Sevilla).
Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Real Madrid 1, Sevilla 0. Arda Güler (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Yan Diomande following a fast break.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, Sevilla 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, Sevilla. Chidera Ejuke replaces Rubén Vargas.
Second Half begins Real Madrid 2, Sevilla 0.
Substitution, Sevilla. Lucas Stassin replaces Robbie Ure.
Substitution, Sevilla. Manu Bueno replaces Peque Fernández.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Sevilla 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Juan Iglesias (Sevilla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Endrick.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Bernardo Silva replaces Jude Bellingham.
Substitution, Sevilla. José Ángel Carmona replaces Juan Iglesias.
Substitution, Sevilla. Alfon González replaces Félix Correia.
Marc Cucurella (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Eduardo Camavinga replaces Arda Güler.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, Sevilla 1. Manu Bueno (Sevilla) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lucas Stassin.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, Sevilla 1. Yan Diomande (Real Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Aurélien Tchouaméni.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Kylian Mbappé.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Éder Militão replaces Federico Valverde.
